meta.title: Fetch chain
meta.description: Adds the "Fetch chain" web fetch provider. Choose it under Settings > Web search and fetch > Web fetch provider. Each web_fetch tries plain HTTP first, then scrape.do, Scrapfly, and Firecrawl in order until one succeeds; a 403, 429, 5xx, timeout, challenge page, unsupported or oversized content, or a service rejection moves to the next step, while 404 and 410 are returned as-is. The result starts with the step that answered, such as "Scrape.do:". Paid services spend credits and receive every URL that reaches them, including intranet URLs. This bundle's settings page sets step order, on/off, timeouts, and rendering options, and stores API keys in the DSH credentials file as SCRAPEDO_API_KEY, SCRAPFLY_API_KEY, and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY; Test checks a key through the service's account lookup. A service without a key is skipped. In conversations started after it loads, the plugin raises the web_fetch time limit from 30 s to the sum of the enabled step timeouts plus 5 s (135 s by default), whichever provider is selected; the settings page can turn this off.
